reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already decides missing, single and ranged amounts for the other consumers.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is delegated entirely to the helper.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler and as an inline intersection type rather than in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity, the API model layer that owns the external schedule shape.

scope.why: Only the handler, its return type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Tiny and correct-by-delegation, though the external shape is now defined in two places (model and handler type).

bypasses_abstraction.where: api.ts api/schedules-get extends scheduleModel.toExternal's output instead of adding the field in the scheduleModel/APIScheduleEntity model.
